scope: Local source and fixture export review; no live provider calls or physical printing

warnings: Print shop file: RGB color, ⅛-inch bleed and crop marks. Confirm the printer’s color-profile and finishing requirements.

findings.observation: The hero is composited into a 1224-pixel masthead spanning 612 PDF points, or 8.5 inches. Source-resolution checking emitted no low-resolution warning for this fixture, although the exported composite is 144 PPI.

The print-shop wrapper fills the bleed with a flat background color and places the original artwork at the trim rectangle. The masthead and paper textures stop at trim; the rendered proof visibly differs outside that boundary.
